description_en: Queries the top N referers of a website
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-top-referer --biz-region cn --domain example.aliyundoc.com --start-time 1701991920 --end-time 1721561100 --limit 10 --query-type example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainTopReferer

parameters.description_en:
